description: Add daily multivitamin as home medication
presentation: Patient is a 28 year old man who has urinary frequency despite treatment for a presumed UTI. Patient has nocturia and workup for polyuria was done. His home medications include a daily multivitamin. CMP and A1c were normal but urine sodium and urine osm were both low. What further workup should be done to work up diabetes insipidus or other etiologies?
